---
description: "Propose the archvow commands that specify a feature described in plain words, or a brief (a file of a briefs folder: briefs/ by default)"
argument-hint: "<the feature, in plain words> | briefs/<file>.md | specs/<feature>/plan.md"
agent: agent
---

Draft the spec of this feature, as AGENTS.md defines "Draft the spec of <feature>" - or, when it is a file of a briefs folder (briefs/, or another folder the project declares), "Draft the spec from <brief>": (the text given with this command)

Propose the commands; run none of them and write no code.
